closer_progress: The product-torus image intersection is proved equal to the Cartesian square of the curve-image intersection; its cardinality is the square of the curve-intersection cardinality, so oddness transfers. Remaining work is constructing the four punctured curves with odd curve intersection and proving ambient nonhomotopy under every open embedding.
